items.title: Snap Just Dropped 17% in a Month on Ad Growth “Below Our Ambitions.” Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysSnap stock fell 17% in the past month, mostly after a third-quarter report with 4% ad growth and a user miss. Meta Platforms, Pinterest and Reddit all grew revenue far faster than Snap’s ads, so the slowdown looks like Snap’s own.

items.title: Why We Prefer Alphabet Stock Over Meta Right Now
items.summary: Our Monday piece, Should You Be Worried About Meta Stock?, opened on a split result: Meta Platforms (META) grew revenue 26% in its September quarter, yet its operating income fell 37%. The fall came from one item, a $9.9 billion legal charge; without it, the company says operating income would have risen 11%. So the next question is the one an owner of either AI giant asks: if you are buying one of them now, Meta or Alphabet (GOOGL.
